name: personalisierter-song.de
description: A German Shopify store that sells personalized songs for birthdays, weddings and anniversaries at €39.90 per song, ready in under 10 minutes; plants a tree per order (company-stated). Founded Jan 2025, DE. ~4,000 estimated users. Channels: SEO, newsletter, Google Ads, Meta Ads. Seller says it runs ~1 hour/week with automated production and delivery (founder-stated). Listed for sale at $85,000 (1.0x; first listed Oct 7, 2026).

mentions.evidence: MRR $0, ~$6,394 L30 (−23.9%), ~$26,927 last 3 months, ~$144,418 last 12 months, ~$194,376 all-time, ~54% L30 profit margin. Revenue synced Oct 8, 2026 ~09:54 Warsaw (07:54 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Clone for PL: "spersonalizowana piosenka" for imieniny / ślub / rocznica at 149–199 PLN, with Meta Ads on Instagram gift season and a Shopify + TTS/music pipeline. Or buy this one and add PL/EN locales.

whyItPrints: Emotional gifts with a fixed SKU and automated fulfilment. No seats, no churn meetings — just ads → checkout → generated file. ~$194k all-time at roughly 1.0x asking price is a clean, small acquisition for someone who wants a DE gift brand.
